reason: The comment at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:72-73 still says the topic-list cell default is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`. The patch changed that default to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))` (desktop/topic-list.scss, patch lines 538-562) and changed the coldmap rules just below it (discourse.scss:76-82). The comment therefore now only describes the light-theme value.
